landing.heroSubtitle: League, cup or blitz. Random draws, real opponents and a table that moves with every result. Here, whoever wins proves it.

formats.title: League, Cup and Blitz
formats.body: Round robin down to the last matchday. Single elimination where one mistake sends you home. Or blitz, to crown a champion in an afternoon.

trust.title: The score isn't up for debate
trust.body: Both players report the result. If they don't match, the match freezes until the organizers look at the screenshots and call it.

reputation.title: You earn your name on the pitch
reputation.body: Five stars built from play: how you do, whether you show up on time, and whether you stand by the result. Nobody climbs by dodging opponents.

multi.title: Your community, your ground
multi.body: Your logo, your color, your people. One account for the player and a space of your own for you.

how.step1: Create your community and drop the code in your Discord.
how.step2: Pick the format, the game mode and how many get in.
how.step3: Close registration and the draw decides the matchups.
how.step4: They play. They upload the screenshot and confirm the score.
how.step5: The table moves on its own until one champion is left.
